name: Tanishq Jewellery - Mumbai - Matunga
description: Welcome to Tanishq, your trusted jewellery store in Matunga, Mumbai. Explore over 8,000 exquisite gold and diamond jewellery designs, including earrings, rings, pendants, mangalsutras, bangles, bracelets and necklaces - all crafted by skilled karigars. Backed by Tata Trusts, our jewellery guarantees purity, features 100% natural diamonds, and comes with a transparent gold exchange policy. Enjoy lifetime maintenance and cleaning on jewellery purchased from Tanishq. Whether you're shopping for weddings, engagements, men's jewellery or daily wear, our knowledgeable staff is here to help you find the perfect piece. Visit the Tanishq showroom for a refined jewellery shopping experience.

featured_reviews.name: Yutika S
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at the Tanishq store in Matunga. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming and attentive, making the entire shopping process smooth and enjoyable.

A special mention to Sharayu and Aniket, who were absolutely fantastic. They were patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely interested in helping me find exactly what I was looking for. They took the time to understand my preferences, explained the designs and pricing clearly, and never made me feel rushed or pressured.

Their professionalism and warm approach truly stood out and made the visit memorable. It’s rare to come across such dedicated customer service these days. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this store to anyone looking for a pleasant and trustworthy jewelry shopping experience!

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeev Bajpai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tanishq at Matunga Mumbai has been very  always very good with quality assurances from Tata , ambiance, and contemporary design jewellery.

Their team  including Deepti , Anjali and Vikram are very warm and knowledgeable.

Location is central with ease of wallet parking. Go for it!!

Special thanks for birthday celebrations every year with cakes at Tanishq.

Thank you !

featured_reviews.name: Farzan Pagdiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: It is always a great experience shopping at Tanishq Matunga Branch. Vikram Soni assisted us so well and suggested some great deals as well. We had a wonderful experience. Also, special mention of Anushka who has been of tremendous help.  She even helped us decide on some beautiful designs and made my wife feel special. I recommend this store for their valuable service and hospitality.  THANK YOU!

featured_reviews.name: Subhash Shiraskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Revisiting Tanishq after 14 years felt truly special. The last time we visited was before my marriage, and of course a lot has changed since then — people, interiors, designs, and definitely the gold rates!

But what has beautifully remained the same is the warmth, hospitality, empathy, and genuine understanding of customer needs. From the moment we walked in, it never felt like 14 years had passed. That consistency in customer experience reflects the true Tata culture.

A very special mention to Mr. Deepak Trivedi for his immense patience, guidance, and determination to help us through every step without ever making us feel rushed. His professionalism and calm approach made the entire experience even more memorable.

It was not just shopping for jewellery, but an experience filled with trust, comfort, and nostalgia.
Thank you once again to the entire team at Tanishq for making our visit so memorable. ✨

featured_reviews.name: P G
featured_reviews.review_text:
An exceptional experience at Tanishq Matunga, where purity, assurance, and elegance combine to make every moment precious.

The store exudes warmth and authenticity.

The staff ensures you feel special and cherished at every step, from the warm welcome to the final purchase.

A special mention to Anjali. Each time, she guides me with genuine interest and makes the entire selection process effortless.

What I appreciate most is the personalized attention given by Anjali and the entire team, in choosing the perfect jewellery, much like a family member would.

I highly recommend this place for anyone seeking not only beautiful jewellery but also a beautiful experience.

featured_reviews.name: Gulafsha Siddiqui

We had a wonderful experience with Tanishq. The overall service was excellent, and everything was handled very smoothly.
A special thanks to Nidhi kidecha  for her support—she was बेहद helpful, polite, and guided us perfectly throughout. She made our experience even better and more comfortable.
Highly recommended!
